from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EpsRecord(BaseModel):
    """Basic and Diluted EPS data for one company in one reporting period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date in YYYY-MM format")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="Basic earnings per share amount for this period")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share amount for this period")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial report (e.g., '10-Q')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[EpsRecord]
